meta.promptText: Mujhe India mein 3000 rupees ke andar running shoes kharidne hain. Konse lene chahiye?

response.text:
Bharat mein 3000 rupees ke budget mein running shoes ke liye kaafi saare acche aur durable options mil jaate hain jo beginners ya daily joggers ke liye perfect hain.

Yahan kuch behtareen running shoes ki list di gayi hai jo is budget mein aate hain:

---

### ## Top Running Shoes Under ₹3000 in India

| Brand & Model | Approx. Price | Best For | Key Features |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Campus OXYFIT / Camp-Bounce** | ₹1,200 - ₹1,800 | Daily Jogging & Walking | Lightweight, breathable mesh upper, good cushioning for daily use. |
| **Asian Wonder-13 / Fire-Fly** | ₹800 - ₹1,400 | Budget Runners & Gym | Value for money, flexible sole, comfortable fit. |
| **Sparx SM-651 / SX0332G** | ₹1,000 - ₹1,700 | Road Running & Casual | Durable outsole, sturdy grip, long-lasting build quality. |
| **Bata Power (Entry-level variants)** | ₹1,500 - ₹2,500 | Neutral Running | Great arch support, reliable brand comfort, breathable fabric. |
| **Red Tape Sports Shoes** | ₹1,200 - ₹2,200 (on sale) | Stylish Running & Gym | Often heavily discounted online, stylish look with decent cushioning. |
| **Campus First / Active Series** | ₹1,800 - ₹2,500 | Regular Running | Better shock absorption and premium mesh material compared to base models. |

---

### ## Kuch Zaruri Baatein (Buying Tips)

* **Online Sales Check Karein:** Flipkart aur Amazon par in brands (khaaskar Campus, Sparx, aur Red Tape) par aksar sales ya discounts chalte hain, jisse ₹3000 tak ke shoes aur bhi kam daam mein mil sakte hain.
* **Size Guide:** Agar aap online order kar rahe hain, toh ek size bada order karne ka sochein kyunki running ke dauran paanv thode phulte hain aur shoes mein thodi jagah honi chahiye.
* **Usage:** Agar aap sirf morning walk ya light jogging karte hain, toh **Campus** ya **Sparx** sabse best value denge. Agar aapko regular running (5km+) karni hai, toh thoda dhyaan rakhein ki sole mein accha bounce aur cushioning ho.

Aapko inmein se kis brand ya type ka design sabse zyada pasand hai?
